items.q: That was the area that Big Mabel -- I just couldn't see -- and it was so hard for women to break through

ctx.x: One of them -- they very -- they turn out -- I wasn't particular about wanting them to get into show business, because at that time the show business was so bad, you know. People were getting on dope and stuff, like that. That was the area that Big Mabel -- I just couldn't see -- and it was so hard for women to break through and the travelling was hard on them, you know. I remember what Ella went through the years we was on the road with Chick. It's really a rough thing for a girl vocalist on the road. Because…
